# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** six or seven years old  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is a neat and proper character with gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a "prunes and prisms" mouth. She wears her hair in long, sleek curls that never fall out of order, and dresses in a nicely starched white dress accented by a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a lovely, industrious child who is notably quiet, faithful, and observant. Described as prim and proper, she comports herself as a well-behaved model child, remaining meek and demure by speaking only when spoken to. She approaches her duties and tasks carefully, systematically, and dispassionately, never needing to be told how to do something twice. Even in trying situations, she remains motionless and composed.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), +7 more_

## History

Dora Keith moved to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), where she was subjected to his troublesome pranks, including being pushed into a pigpen and locked in a toolhouse. At school, she was frightened by ghost stories told by a classmate. Following the death of her uncle [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), who left money in trust for the twins, it was established that Dora and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) would remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), +10 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

Dora is the twin sister of [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), whom [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Unlike Dora's well-behaved nature, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) constantly engages in disruptive behavior at her expense, such as causing her to fall into a pigpen and locking her in a toolhouse before lying about her whereabouts. Despite Davy's unruly pranks, they continue to reside together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after their uncle extends their stay.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +19 more_
